marketing_description: The DeWALT DCN930B Framing Nailer offers cordless convenience, allowing users to save time in setup and clean-up. This tool features a brushless motor and innovative flywheel that stays active for 6 seconds after the trigger is released, and can install up to 530 sqft of subflooring per charge. It is part of the MAX XR Series and has a 30 deg magazine angle, with a lightweight design that removes the need for hoses and compressors.
